cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: @goparrot-dashboard/app 0.0.2 contains only package.json and index.js; its preinstall script runs node index.js. The script runs the hostname and whoami commands, reads the working directory, then performs a DNS lookup of <user>.<hostname>.rootxravi.iuczektmwpudhwqnsbkgc6m8nx2dgn5vc.oast.fun and an HTTPS request to https://iuczektmwpudhwqnsbkgc6m8nx2dgn5vc.oast.fun/rootxravi-poc with the package name, hostname, user name, working directory and a timestamp in the query string. Errors are silently ignored. Only version 0.0.2 has an install script; 0.0.1 and 0.0.3 do not. Remove the package and treat machines that installed 0.0.2 as having disclosed their hostname, user name and working directory to a third party.
